correctness.rationale: The assigned graph has 20 vertices and 35 edges including the four row-reversing seam edges. Independent recursion from that graph produced precisely 255300 matchings including the empty simplex, nonempty face vector (35,505,3910,17725,48197,77455,69770,31630,5820,252), reduced Euler 164; the ordinary seam gives reduced Euler 136. The inspected deterministic toggle discrete Morse construction pairs 127550 faces and checks no gradient cycles, leaving one 0-cell, 181 6-cells and 17 7-cells; signed 181x17 integer differential has 17 unit pivots. Its unit Smith form realizes homotopic cancellations because the Morse CW model is 5-connected and 7-cell attaching maps into the wedge of 6-spheres are integer degrees. The separate reverse matching has a degree5 critical cell and verifies d^2=0, consistent with wedge 164 S6. Computational exhaustion applies to this one finite graph only.
